result.description:
Summary: 
Join a world-leading School of Computer Science and Engineering and help shape the next generation of software engineers through innovative, high-quality teaching across contemporary Software Engineering disciplines.

Job Details
•	Salary, 
o	Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $127,947 to $150,830 per annum + 17% superannuation
o	Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $155,403 to $178,290 per annum + 17% superannuation
•	Full-time
•	2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
•	Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
Join the School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in an Education Focused role. In this role, you will contribute to excellence in teaching and learning across Software Engineering, while helping to shape the next generation of software engineering professionals and computing graduates.

You will contribute to teaching across Software Engineering disciplines at undergraduate and postgraduate levels, delivering engaging learning experiences that prepare students for industry and research careers. You will play a key role in curriculum development, innovative teaching practice, and enhancing the student learning experience across the School.

With established strengths in software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and systems, UNSW offers an exceptional environment for educators who are passionate about teaching excellence, curriculum innovation, and student success. You will contribute to a collaborative academic community committed to advancing education and preparing students for real-world impact.

This is an opportunity to join a global leader in Computer Science, with cutting-edge facilities, world-class faculty, and an innovative educational environment. With strong industry partnerships and a commitment to educational excellence, UNSW provides excellent opportunities for career development, collaboration, and impact.

About You
You are an engaging and passionate educator with expertise in Software Engineering and a commitment to delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences. You bring the ability to contribute to an inclusive and high-performing academic environment while supporting students across a range of Software Engineering disciplines.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will contribute to teaching, curriculum development, and student support across undergraduate and postgraduate courses, while continuing to develop your teaching practice and educational innovation capabilities.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate educational leadership through curriculum innovation, mentoring colleagues, leading teaching initiatives, and contributing to the advancement of teaching excellence across the School and broader UNSW Education Focused community.
You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to create meaningful learning experiences while building strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige, and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides a unique environment where academic expertise translates into real world outcomes. The university is home to cutting edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields. For academics, UNSW offers an outstanding platform to flourish — combining world class facilities, collaborative networks, and a culture of innovation that supports both career growth and meaningful contributions to the wider community.

The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and Bioinformatics, as well as a number of combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading and world building as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Actively stays up to date with discipline knowledge and professional development.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
•	Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience in work-integrated learning (desirable).
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Actively stays up to date with discipline knowledge and development.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience in implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others.
•	Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning. 
•	Evidence of professional development of teaching practice in self and others with the ability to advance and lead an inclusive culture of excellence in learning and teaching.
•	Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement.
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Additional details about the specific responsibilities for this position can be found in the position description. This is available via JOBS@UNSW. 

To Apply: 
If you are an educator passionate about delivering high-quality teaching and enhancing the student learning experience, whether as an emerging or experienced academic, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to innovative teaching practices, curriculum development, and educational excellence within the School. We encourage you to click the “Apply Now” button and submit your CV, cover letter, and responses addressing the Skills and Experience criteria.

If you're excited about this role and think you have what it takes, but your experience doesn't align 100%, we still want to hear from you and would encourage you to apply.

If you have had any interruption in your career, you are encouraged to include a ROPE statement as part of your application. For information on ROPE please check: 
https://www.arc.gov.au/about-arc/program-policies/research-opportunity-and-performance-evidence-rope-statement

Located in Yatala, GCI is the perfect location for Gold Coast and Brisbane living.

Over the last 20 years the GCI Group has introduced some of the latest start of the art technology to deliver world-class results that represent the very best in local manufacturing such as transport, mining, electrical, agriculture, construction, and defence.

About the role:
Due to growth within our business, we are looking for full time Welders to join our team. Reporting to the Foreman, you will be a part of a capable and motivated team who strive for excellence and will undertake a wide range of general assisting activities throughout the business.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

Why work with GCI?

By being part of our team, you’ll:
Learn from industry veterans and receive frequent training opportunities.
Work in a clean, professional, and supportive environment.
Become part of a team that genuinely invests in the community.
Enjoy competitive rates, frequent staff perks and a positive workplace culture.

If you’re interested in this fantastic opportunity, hit the "Apply Now" button with your current resume and brief cover letter.

result.description: AARON MARINE OFFSHORE AUSTRALIA PTY. LTD.   ABOUT THE ROLE   AMO Australia is seeking an experienced Fire Protection Equipment Technician to conduct inspection, testing, service, maintenance, repair and recertification support for marine fire protection equipment and related safety systems onboard vessels, offshore installations, shipyards and at AMO workshop facilities.  The role is primarily focused on portable and fixed marine fire-fighting equipment and fire suppression systems. As AMO’s operations involve both fire-fighting equipment services and life-saving appliance services, the successful candidate will be required to support lifeboat, rescue boat, davit, winch and related LSA inspection, maintenance and testing activities in accordance with company procedures, manufacturer instructions, and applicable class, flag and customer requirements.  The successful candidate will work as part of a safety-critical service team and must operate strictly within documented competence, company approval, manufacturer authorisation where required, and applicable regulatory requirements. Honest defect reporting, correct system reinstatement and refusal to pass non-compliant equipment are non-negotiable requirements of the position.            Benefits   Task & responsibilities   General Duties    Carry out Maintenance, Overhaul, Repair and Test (MROT) work in accordance with approved procedures, OEM instructions, Class/Flag/customer requirements and company standards.  Prepare for each job by checking the job scope, procedure, risk assessment, permit requirements, tools, calibrate test equipment, spare parts, service kits and required documentation.  Conduct or participate in toolbox talks, risk assessments, isolation checks, permit-to-work controls and barricading before safety-critical work.  Use correct PPE and always follow vessel/site safety requirements.  Stop working immediately where a procedure, equipment condition, lifting arrangement, pressure system, release system, electrical/control system or work environment is unsafe.  Report defects honestly and clearly, even where there is customer pressure to pass equipment.  Do not bypass safety devices, defeat interlocks, shortcut functional tests or leave systems incorrectly reset.  Maintain tools, service kits, workshop equipment and company property in clean, safe and serviceable condition.    Primary Duties - Marine Fire Protection Equipment and Fixed Suppression Systems    Inspect, test, service, maintain, recharge/refill, pressure-test or arrange testing of portable and mobile fire extinguishers within company approval and technician competence.  Inspect and service fire hoses, nozzles, hydrants, international shore connections, fire blankets, fireman outfits, BA sets, BA cylinders, SCBA, EEBDs, medical oxygen equipment and associated compressed gas cylinders as applicable.  Check pressure, weight, seals, hoses, nozzles, cylinders, valves, gauges, hydrostatic test dates, expiry dates, brackets, labels, physical condition, accessibility and correct stowage/location.  Inspect, test, maintain and troubleshoot fixed fire-fighting and suppression systems including CO2 systems, foam systems, water mist systems, wet chemical systems, dry powder systems, helideck foam systems and related control/release arrangements, where within documented competence.  Inspect CO2 cylinders, cylinder banks, manifolds, flexible hoses, discharge piping, nozzles, release cabinets, pull cables, pilot cylinders, discharge heads, bursting discs, non-return valves and pressure-operated controls.  Check remote release stations, manual release controls, time-delay units, alarms, ventilation shutdowns, fuel shutdowns, fire dampers, lockable release arrangements, operating instructions and warning signage.  Carry out functional testing of alarms, release controls, shutdowns, pressure switches, flow switches, pumps, valves and control panels without accidental discharge and ensure systems are correctly reset and returned to operational condition.  Inspect and maintain BA compressors, air quality testing equipment and associated compressor/cylinder systems where trained and authorised.  Clearly tag and immediately report impaired, isolated, disconnected, expired, defective or unsafe fire protection equipment or systems to the vessel/client and AMO supervisor.       Secondary Duties - LSA, Lifeboat, Rescue Boat, Davit and Winch Support    Assist with inspection, service, maintenance, repair, testing and recertification support for lifeboats, rescue boats, davits, winches, launching appliances, release systems and associated deck safety equipment.  Support annual and five-year inspections, operational tests, load tests, winch/davit checks, launching/recovery checks and related documentation in accordance with SOLAS, MSC.402(96), class/flag/customer requirements and manufacturer instructions where applicable.  Inspect or assist with internal and external lifeboat/rescue boat checks, boat handling/maneuvering checks, winch and davit operation, wire/fall condition, release gear condition, hook/release arrangements and safety-critical components.  Assist with troubleshooting and maintenance of inboard/outboard engines fitted to lifeboats or rescue boats where within competence.  Support inspection/maintenance of related LSA and marine safety equipment including lifejackets, immersion suits, liferafts, EBS equipment, transfer baskets, gangways, accommodation ladders, pilot ladders and lifting gear where required by AMO operations and within documented competence.  Identify and report corrosion, mechanical damage, expiry/test date issues, defective release gear, damaged FRP structure, failed operational tests, missing labels/certificates and unsafe or non-compliant equipment.    Job Documentation and Reporting    Prepare accurate service reports, inspection checklists, test records, certificates, defect lists, job completion records and recommendations.  Record serial numbers, expiry dates, pressure readings, weights, hydrotest dates, test results, defects, ...  Read more: https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5949555

result.description:
Seven Corp on behalf of Reofast


Overview: 

Reofast supplies, fabricates and installs reinforcing steel for premium residential builders across Perth, taking projects from take-off and quotation through to fabrication, delivery and installation. The business is committed to delivering high-quality reinforcement solutions through accuracy, efficiency and exceptional customer service.

We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our team in Perth, WA. In this role, you will be responsible for analysing structural and architectural drawings, preparing quantity take-offs and cost estimates, and developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to support the accurate supply, fabrication and delivery of reinforcement steel products. This is a full-time ongoing position working 38 hours per week.


Main tasks:

-	Analysing structural and architectural drawings to determine reinforcement steel requirements for construction projects.
-	Preparing detailed quantity take-offs and cost estimates for steel supply, fabrication and delivery.
-	Developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to ensure quantities align with structural and engineering drawings.
-	Preparing pricing breakdowns for materials, fabrication and logistics to support quotations and tender submissions.
-	Coordinating with structural engineers, architects, builders, site teams and suppliers to confirm project requirements, quantities and pricing.
-	Reviewing project variations and updating estimates, quantities and costs accordingly.
-	Preparing marked-up drawings and maintaining accurate estimating information across internal software systems.
-	Managing workload, priorities and deadlines to ensure quotations and reinforcement schedules are completed on time.
-	Liaising with clients and builders to ensure estimating is based on the latest project documentation.
-	Monitoring stock levels and assisting with supplier orders as required.
-	Maintaining accurate estimating records and reports.
-	Performing any additional duties as required from time to time.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Relevant qualification in Construction, Building, Engineering or a related discipline.
-	Alternatively, at least five years of relevant construction estimating experience may substitute for the formal qualification.


Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Strong communication skills with clients, staff and site tradespersons.
-	High attention to detail and accuracy.
-	Ability to read and interpret structural and architectural drawings.
-	Sound understanding of construction site operations and project requirements.
-	Ability to prepare accurate reinforcement schedules within required timeframes.
-	Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage priorities, workloads and deadlines.
-	Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with clients and suppliers.
-	Solutions-focused with a proactive and can-do attitude.
-	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Notion and Slack.
-	Ability to maintain accurate estimating records and reports.


 Annual salary will be between $90,000.00 to $110,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.


Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

•	Forrestfield, WA, 6058 - From $79,500 
•	Geraldton, WA, 6530 - $85,000
•	Port Hedland, WA, 6721 - $105,000 

These positions are -
•	Full Time Permanent
•	Various rosters available
•	Tool Allowance $35.00 paid fortnightly
•	ASAP Start !

The key responsibilities for these roles include: 
•	Spray paint and sand blast road transport equipment.
•	Preparing surfaces for paint application
•	Mix and colour match paints to meet the requirements of the job.
•	Brush touch, paint/blend any defective areas of coated items.
•	Clean work areas and spray equipment.
•	Good people and communication skills.
•	Support and endorse the company vision, mission and family values.
•	Meet deadlines & quality requirements to satisfy customer demand.
•	Perform all duties whilst adhering to WHS requirements, & always with the correct use of PPE.

Required skills and experience:

Bruce Rock Engineering is a leading quality designer, builder and service provider of road transport equipment in Australia. We offer a complete range of trailer solutions to the agricultural, mining, construction and general freight industries nationwide. With the lightest tare weights in Australia, our innovative, high quality trailers are engineered for reliability, durability and performance.

•	Employee of the Month and Employee of the Year program with great prizes.
•	Ability to participate in our Employee Referral Program (up to $5000 per referral!).
•	Mental health support and EAP services free of charge to you and your family

result.description:
Seven Corp on behalf of Adelaide Steel Frame Windows

Overview: 

Adelaide Steel Frame Windows is South Australia’s largest manufacturer of architectural steel doors and windows. Operating successfully for over 24 years, our continued growth has led to a recent expansion into a larger facility in Regency Park. We take immense pride in our craftsmanship, solid work ethic, and supportive team culture.

We are seeking a dedicated, full-time Metal Machinist / CNC Specialist to join our production team. In this role, your primary responsibility will be setting up, programming, and operating precision tools and machinery to shape high-tolerance steel components for our bespoke architectural doors and windows.

This position is ideal for a precision-focused tradesperson with comprehensive experience in both complex manual milling and turning operations alongside advanced CNC programming. Working alongside our workshop floor team, you will enhance productivity, ensure strict quality control, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, and assist in mentoring apprentice team members.

Main Tasks:

-	Interpret complex technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications to determine job requirements, tooling needs, and sequence of machining operations.
-	 Set up, program, and operate a variety of machine tools including CNC processing machines, lathes, milling machines, and precision grinders to shape steel components.
-	Calculate engineering parameters, feed rates, and cutting speeds; check fabricated components for conformity and extreme precision using micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
-	Embrace daily tradesperson challenges to diagnose, troubleshoot, and enhance overall machining and manufacturing processes.
-	Work closely alongside the workshop floor team to achieve optimal assembly timeframes, minimise material wastage, and maintain high-quality project outcomes.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum AQF Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Machining)
-	A minimum of one year of full-time proven professional experience setting up, programming, and operating both CNC and manual metalworking machinery, or
-	At least 3 years of relevant experience as a Metal Machinist to substitute the formal qualification.
-	Forklift license 
-	White card
-	Current driver’s license.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Demonstrated ability to write, edit, and optimise CNC programs (G-code/M-code or conversational) at the machine control panel.
-	High proficiency in traditional manual turning, milling, drilling, and surface grinding techniques.
-	Advanced skill in using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, height gauges, dial indicators, calipers) to hold tight tolerances.
-	Sound understanding of metal properties (specifically structural and architectural steel grades), insert selection, speeds, feeds, and coolant applications.
-	Strong spatial awareness and ability to convert complex 2D/3D engineering drawings into finished physical components.
-	Strong diagnostic skills for troubleshooting machining chatter, tool wear, and alignment issues.
-	Pride in producing clean, accurate, and repeatable craftsmanship suited for premium architectural applications.

If you are a motivated, Metal Machinist looking to become a critical part of our leading steel frame manufacturing business, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your machinery experience, CNC programming capabilities, and alignment with our team values via the application link.

Annual salary will be between $75,000.00 to $85,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.
